items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: I’m playing with Rex Stewart and a lot of other jazz musicians.

ctx.x: Did you ever have to do non-musical jobs to augment your income?

No. I’ve been very fortunate. Thank you for asking that question. I’ve been very fortunate just to play the clarinet. And I’m one of the few guys that I can think of that didn’t have to make a living by playing saxophone, clarinet and flute. I just wanted to be a specialist on the clarinet. I wanted to play jazz, I wanted to play classical, I’m able to play Klezmer music. I’ve been just specialized on the clarinet. I brought you some pictures I’ll show you later, taken of me at Jimmy Ryan’s, and someone took them…
Well the list of people you’ve been with is just unbelievable.
